question: How should the knowledge-seat be prepared for the scripture explanation?
premises: The ritual takes place on a smeared, four-cornered ground used as a seat.
A triad of lotuses is arranged to form the knowledge-seat.
The knowledge-seat should measure six finger-breadths.
inference: The teacher should construct a six-finger-breadth knowledge-seat made of three lotuses on a prepared four-cornered ground.
uncertainties: The exact interpretation of rasavahnyaṅgulaṃ as six finger-breadths follows a common numerical code but is not explicit in the verse.
plain_english: On a smeared, four-cornered ground, one should make a knowledge-seat consisting of three lotuses. This seat should measure six finger-breadths.
